hints.title: Bottleneck Path Formulation
hints.text: Think of finding a path from top-left to bottom-right where the maximum elevation encountered along the path is minimized.

hints.title: Shortest Path with Minimax Edge
hints.text: The problem translates to shortest path with bottleneck edge weights.

hints.title: Greedy Frontier Expansion
hints.text: Use best-first search starting from the origin cell, always expanding the unvisited neighbor that minimizes the maximum water height reached so far.

hints.title: See the blueprint

variables: N: grid size (N x N cells)
complexity.notes: Modified Dijkstra algorithm using min-priority queue over N^2 grid cells.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Plain DFS or unweighted BFS does not prioritize lower elevation cells and may explore exponentially many suboptimal paths.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Visited matrix and priority queue store at most N^2 entries.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Use Dijkstra with max(dist, cell) relaxation or binary search over elevation range with BFS reachability.
